مَزْحَفَةٌ a n. of place, sing. of مَزَاحِفُ, (TK,)
which signifies The places of the creeping of serpents; (S, K, TA;) and the marks, or tracks, of the passage thereof: (TA:) and ↓ مَزْحَفٌ , likewise signifies the mark, or track, of a serpent, upon the ground; like مَسْحَفٌ. (TA in art. سحف.) ―
-b2- مَزَاحِفُ also signifies The places of fighting of a party, or people. (TA.) ―
-b3- And (tropical:) The places of pouring [of the water] of the clouds; (TA;) the places where falls the rain of the clouds. (K, TA. [In the CK, السَّحَابُ is erroneously put for السَّحَابِ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
